idea-plugin.name: Valkey Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Valkey/Redis keys and values directly from IntelliJ IDEA. Features:
  • Browse all keys via SCAN cursor
  • View values of all data types (string, list, hash, set, sorted set, stream)
  • SSL/TLS connection support
  • Username+password authentication (Redis 6+)
  • Multiple saved connection profiles
  • Connection timeout configuration
  • DB index selector
